notes.title: Jennifer Wilde Update - September 2022
notes.content:
Hello, everyone! 

The year is cracking on apace - it’s hard to believe it’s September already! August was a busy month for us, and included a trip to Germany for this year’s GamesCom! Head honcho Stephen and programmer Daniel headed off to Cologne for the trade fair’s first in-person event since 2020. 

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39261115/fa737ea80df4a3bfceda0010a6a67bc6fd1ebf0c.jpg[/img]

Stephen says: “It was a real thrill to be back at Gamescom this year. We spent most of the event in the business halls, talking to lots of industry friends we hadn't seen in at least 3 years, and making lots of exciting studio plans for the next few years.  

“We did get a chance to have a quick browse of the public expo, and it was amazing to see so many gamers back in one place, and share their enthusiasm for all the amazing new games on show!” 

As for Jennifer Wilde, the game is now officially 'In Review' behind the scenes at Steam. All being well, we'll have our build approved soon, and will be able to announce our launch date! 

It’s been a busy month for some of our team in their lives beyond Outsider, too. Lead writer Maura McHugh was over in London this weekend for FantasyCon 2022, but don’t worry if you missed it - can also catch her at this year’s Octocon, the National Irish Science Fiction Convention! Find out more at [url=https://2022.octocon.com/]the Octocon website[/url] or follow Maura on Twitter [url=https://twitter.com/splinister]@splinister[/url]. 

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39261115/11d3ab891a1898de73577a85570c009fee38f0c1.jpg[/img]

You might remember from our last update that our social media manager, Hero, was nominated for a British Fantasy Award for Best Audio for their podcast, Monstrous Agonies. We're absolutely delighted to report that they won! 🥳 

If you’d like to check out the best of British fantasy audio fiction, search for Monstrous Agonies on your favourite podcast app or find them on Twitter [url=https://twitter.com/Monstrous_Pod]@Monstrous_Pod[/url]. 

As for the rest of the team, it was business as usual working on the last few bugs in Jennifer Wilde as well as cracking on apace on our super top secret projects that are yet to be announced. And I’m sure none of us felt any jealousy at all on seeing Stephen and Daniel’s holiday pics. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39261115/9787ea7c82122f9de80d25ac15d9e43126ad6551.jpg[/img] 

….nope, not jealous at all 🙃 

That’s all from us this month, but remember to follow us on Twitter, Facebook and Instagram for news and updates. You can also join our Discord server, where we hold weekly hang-outs and self-promotion events with our community. 

See you next month! 

Stephen and the team at Outsider Games.

notes.title: Jennifer Wilde Update - August 2022
notes.content:
Hello, everyone!

We’ve got a bumper update for you this month, with news about Jennifer Wilde, Wailing Heights, and a couple of projects on the Outsider Games radar that we want to share with you.

Work on Jennifer Wilde is cracking on apace, with the team hard at work rooting out those last few bugs...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39261115/f2c301b0ec0b15a5697e5740259953fd51d31226.gif[/img]

If you just can’t wait to get your hands on some Outsider Games goodness, our body-hopping musical adventure Wailing Heights is going on sale this week as part of the Playstation Summer Sale. Pick it up for a song from Aug 3rd to Aug 17th!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39261115/f1e1393e96c4e2d876d2a36e53f452838ac8aa81.png[/img]

There’s been some good news for one of the Outsider Games team, too. When they’re not tweeting and making memes about Oscar Wilde, our social media manager Hero runs a podcast called Monstrous Agonies, a late-night radio advice show for monsters. And last week, Monstrous Agonies was shortlisted for a British Fantasy Award! 🥳 Check out the show at [url=https://www.monstrousagonies.co.uk]monstrousagonies.co.uk[/url] or give it a listen on [url=https://podcasts.apple.com/gb/podcast/monstrous-agonies/id1533872115]iTunes[/url], [url=https://open.spotify.com/show/6udYDZpnfn1FKb8sPB3YQ6?si=c3ee3d629cbc4dae]Spotify[/url], or wherever you get your podcasts. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39261115/e294640512d6507c2c3a47c22aa8437debcffd70.png[/img]

Finally, we want to give a shout-out to Fogtown, a Sherlock Holmes-inspired comedic mystery made with puppets! The team plan to make both a television series and a choice-driven narrative adventure game, and have just launched their crowdfunding campaign, which you can find [url=https://seedandspark.com/fund/fogtown#story]here[/url]. You can also follow them on Twitter, [url=https://twitter.com/fogtownseries]@FogtownSeries[/url], or find out more at their [url=https://www.fogtownseries.com/]website[/url]. 

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39261115/0c5a647ec4fc0e96fdf9762434d3e83c4f762da4.jpg[/img]

That’s all from us this month, but remember to follow us on [url=https://twitter.com/OutsiderGames]Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.facebook.com/OutsiderGames]Facebook[/url] and [url=https://www.instagram.com/outsidergames/]Instagram[/url] for news, updates, and the aforementioned Oscar Wilde memes. You can also join our [url=https://t.co/X5SNQaw9lJ]Discord server[/url], where we hold weekly hang-outs and self-promotion events with our community. 

See you next month! 

Stephen and the team at Outsider Games.

notes.title: Jennifer Wilde Update - June 2022
notes.content:
Hello, everyone. 

It’s been all go this month as we crack on with Jennifer Wilde! As we add the finishing touches to the project, there’s plenty of satisfying cheers as we tick off big pillars of the game as complete. 

☑ Script 100% 

☑ Art 100% 

☑ Animation 100% 

☑ Soundtrack 100% 

☐ Audio FX 95% 

☐ Programming 95% 

☐ QA testing 90% 

Since our last update, we’ve gone through an intensive QA process that found more than 300(!) bugs. Thankfully all the big game-breakers are now fixed (we hope!), and all that remains are some medium to minor bugs (including the occasional typo) before expanding our testing circle for a final pass.  

Hopefully there aren't too many more ghosts in the machine to fend off before you can all play the game! 

Somehow, around all that, we managed to find time for the team to meet up in person - most of us for the first time. It’s been strange making this game across the pandemic, and as our team changes and grows, some of just hadn’t had chance to meet face to face since we started work together. But after a little awkwardness (to be expected from a bunch of game devs whose social skills haven’t exactly improved over the last two years... 😅) we quickly fell into step and had a lovely morning together! 

Speaking of the team, we still have three more to introduce you to. Don’t expect much in the way of information about what they’re working on, though. As well as putting the finishing touches to Jennifer Wilde, we’re also working hard on a couple of as-yet-unannounced projects. We’ll tell you more when we’re ready but until then... our lips are sealed 😉 Meet the last of our new recruits: 

[b]Name:[/b] Maura McHugh 
[b]Role:[/b] Writer 
[b]Currently working on:[/b] Jennifer Wilde and … 🤫 
[b]Currently playing:[/b] Destiny 2 (4ever) 

[b]Name:[/b] Leela Collins 
[b]Role:[/b] Producer/Herder of cats 
[b]Currently working on:[/b] bit of this, bit of that 
[b]Currently playing:[/b] Cosy Capitalism the Game (Animal Crossing) 

[b]Name:[/b] Andrew Bell 
[b]Role:[/b] Designer 
[b]Currently working on:[/b] unspeakable horrors 
[b]Currently playing:[/b] Final Fantasy XIV, Elden Ring and Gwent :x 

Finally, comic fans might be interested to know that Maura will be be one of the guests at this year’s Enniskillen Comic Fest, one of a host of talented comic book creators booked for this year’s event. The festival takes place on Saturday June 18th and you can learn more at [url= https://www.facebook.com/EnniskillenComicFest] their Facebook page[/url]. 

Remember to join [url=https://discord.gg/b9NkWQQ3WA]our Discord server[/url] for weekly hang-outs and chats, as well as news and updates. You can also follow us on [url=https://twitter.com/OutsiderGames]Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/outsidergames/]Instagram[/url] and [url=https://www.facebook.com/OutsiderGames]Facebook[/url]. 

That’s all from us. Have a great week, and talk to you next month with another update! 

Stephen and the team at Outsider Games
